"There isn't one chance in a hundred that my cousin still lives. The grave has closed over him long since. The sooner you make up your mind to accept the inevitable the better."

arxiv-2206-15060.title: Discovery of nanographene for hydrogen storage solving low reversibility issues
arxiv-2206-15060.creator: Gagus Ketut Sunnardianto a,b , Yusuf Wicaksono c , Halimah Harfah c , Koichi Kusakabe a
arxiv-2206-15060.description: Abstract We found good reversibility of hydrogen uptake-release in vacancy-centered hexagonal armchair nanographene (VANG) based on density functional theory calculation. VANG has triply hydrogenated vacancy (V 111 ) at the center acts as a self-catalytic property to reduce an activation barrier of hydrogen uptake-release. We found remarkable features in an almost equal value of the activation energy barrier of 1.

arxiv-2301-13235.title: Joint calibration to SPX and VIX options with signature-based models
arxiv-2301-13235.creator: Christa Cuchiero, Guido Gazzani, Janka Möller, Sara Svaluto-Ferro
arxiv-2301-13235.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christa Cuchiero, Guido Gazzani, Janka Möller, Sara Svaluto-Ferro. We consider a stochastic volatility model where the dynamics of the volatility are described by a linear function of the (time extended) signature of a primary process which is supposed to be a polynomial diffusion. We obtain closed form expressions for the VIX squared, exploiting the fact that the truncated signature of a polynomial diffusion is again a polynomial diffusion.

arxiv-2511-02904.title: Classical shadows for sample-efficient measurements of gauge-invariant observables
arxiv-2511-02904.creator: Jacob Bringewatt ∗, Henry Froland ∗, Andreas Elben, Niklas Mueller
arxiv-2511-02904.description: Abstract Classical shadows provide a versatile framework for estimating many properties of quantum states from repeated, randomly chosen measurements without requiring full quantum state tomography. When prior information is available, such as knowledge of symmetries of states and operators, this knowledge can be exploited to significantly improve sample efficiency.

pmc-11381494.title: Can the implementation of the smart city pilot policy improve the social adaptive health and mental health of middle-aged and elderly people? Evidence from China
pmc-11381494.creator: Xuena Liu, Haibin Liu, Hui Huang, Hanwei Zhang, Weiqiang Zhang, Yinglong Shi
pmc-11381494.description: With the accelerating pace of population aging in China and the implementation of the smart city pilot policy, whether the middle-aged and elderly population can integrate and adapt to this “smart” society has become an urgent problem that needs to be solved.

pmc-11477872.title: Toward Stabilizing the Keyhole in Laser Spot Welding of Aluminum: Numerical Analysis
pmc-11477872.creator: Saeid SaediArdahaei, Xuan-Tan Pham
pmc-11477872.description: The inherent instability of laser welding, particularly keyhole instability, poses significant challenges in industrial applications, leading to defects such as porosities that compromise weld quality. Various forces act on the keyhole and molten pool during laser welding, influencing process stability. pmc-11488508.title: A Mixed Study on the Health Education Needs of Caregivers for People Living with Epilepsy Undergoing Surgical Treatment and the Effects of a Health Education Program
pmc-11488508.creator: Shuiying Zeng, Hui Liu, Xiaozhen Wen, Yujing Huang
pmc-11488508.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to understand and address the health education needs of family caregivers of people living with epilepsy, irrespective of the patient’s age. It seeks to construct and implement a targeted health education program informed by empowerment education theory and evaluate its effectiveness.

pmc-11538333.title: Genomic variations associated with risk and protection against vincristine-induced peripheral neuropathy in pediatric cancer patients
pmc-11538333.creator: Kheireddin Mufti, Miguel Cordova, Erika N Scott, Jessica N Trueman, Jessica M Lovnicki, Catrina M Loucks, Shahrad R Rassekh, Colin J D Ross, Bruce C Carleton, On behalf of the Canadian Pharmacogenomics Network for Drug Safety Consortium
pmc-11538333.description: Vincristine-induced peripheral neuropathy is a common and highly debilitating toxicity from vincristine treatment that affects quality of life and often requires dose reduction, potentially affecting survival. Although previous studies demonstrated genetic factors are associated with vincristine neuropathy risk, the clinical relevance of most identified variants is limited by small sample sizes and unclear clinical phenotypes.

pmc-11587960.title: The role of extradiaphragmatic muscles’ ultrasound on the diagnosis and follow-up of diaphragmatic dysfunction associated with cervical septic arthritis: A case report and literature review
pmc-11587960.creator: Alessandro Menozzi, Giovanni Sabbatini, Michele Umbrello, Miriam Gotti, Alessandra Salvioni, Andrea Galimberti, Angelo Pezzi, Paolo Formenti
pmc-11587960.description: Cervical septic arthritis can lead to complications such as epidural abscess, which may result in respiratory failure. We present a case of a 78-year-old male with cervical septic arthritis complicated by epidural abscess, leading to severe diaphragm dysfunction. Ultrasound evaluation revealed dysfunction of the left hemidiaphragm and compensatory activation of accessory respiratory muscles.

pmc-11693177.title: DEVELOPMENT AND ASSESSMENT OF THE VIRTUAL INTERGENERATIONAL COMPARATIVE GLOBAL AGING CURRICULUM
pmc-11693177.creator: Grzegorz Zurek, Alina Zurek, Lyn Holley
pmc-11693177.description: This presentation describes didactic process in the international, experimental, hybrid course, Comparative Global Aging. Created by the University of Nebraska at Omaha and two Polish universities – the University of Wroclaw and the University School of Physical Education in Wroclaw, it was structured to nurture intra- and intergenerational relationships and understanding between students and older adults on different continents.

pmc-11713750.title: Comparative analysis of clinical endpoint progression rates in sporadic Alzheimer’s disease and Down Syndrome‐related Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11713750.creator: Michael Rafii, Jessie Nicodemus‐Johnson, Suzanne B. Hendrix, Jonathan Wagg, Nicolas Fournier, Olivier Sol, Saskia Delpretti, Julien Rongere, Claude Rudaz‐Kohler, Marie Kosco‐Vilbois, Andrea Pfeifer, Johannes Streffer, Nuno Mendonca, Mitchell Wassom, Zayne Kirkham
pmc-11713750.description: BackgroundClinical assessments utilized in trials to measure progression in sporadic Alzheimer’s disease (SAD) such as the MMSE, ADAS‐Cog, CDR‐SB and ADCS‐ADL are well established. Distinct assessments are utilized for Down Syndrome‐related Alzheimer’s disease (DSAD). Although these assessments are less well established, they probe comparable domains of cognition and function.

pmc-12586326.title: Avança Saúde SP: driving the digital transformation of primary healthcare in São Paulo
pmc-12586326.creator: Cíntia Borges Almeida da Fonseca, Leonardo G Shibata, Márcia Gomes Rocha, Jennifer A Nelson
pmc-12586326.description: This study examines how digital tools can redesign primary healthcare systems, focusing on the digital transformation activities implemented by the Avança Saúde SP program in São Paulo, Brazil. With investments of US$200 million, the 5-year program (2019–2024) aimed to expand coverage and improve primary healthcare for the São Paulo population through investments in technology, management and infrastructure.

pmc-12652630.title: Research on the Distribution Characteristics of Urea-Formaldehyde Resin Gel Influenced by Structural Development in Fractured-Vuggy Reservoirs
pmc-12652630.creator: Zhengcong Song, Weipeng Wu, Ming Qu, Jiaxin Xi, Min Yang, Xingliang Jia, Yuheng Zhao, Lu Liu, Haihua Cui
pmc-12652630.description: Profile control is widely employed to improve oil recovery in fractured-vuggy carbonate reservoirs. However, the limitation of current experimental evaluation methods restricts their practical guidance for field applications. In this study, urea-formaldehyde resin gel (URG) is studied using SEM, rheological analysis, FTIR, and Raman spectroscopy. Typical structural models of fractured-vuggy reservoirs are fabricated by 3D printing technology.

pmc-12710244.title: Old germs, novel approaches – A systematic review on pathogen distribution and therapeutic intervention strategies in periprosthetic joint infections
pmc-12710244.creator: Anina Lange, Soraya Mousavi, Stefan Bereswill, Markus M Heimesaat
pmc-12710244.description: Chronic degenerative diseases including osteoarthritis are on the rise leading to a growing demand for joint replacement surgery in elderly and often multimorbid patients. Periprosthetic joint infections (PJIs) constitute serious complications following endoprosthetic surgery. Increasing prevalences of PJIs by multi-drug resistant and/or biofilm-producing bacteria hinder sufficient anti-infectious treatment especially in vulnerable patients.

pmc-12963424.title: The impact of state and trait general and social anxiety on theory of mind
pmc-12963424.creator: C. Foulds, V. Khudiakova, A. D. R. Surtees
pmc-12963424.description: Theory of mind is an important skill to function in society. There is evidence that anxiety can impair the ability to use this skill effectively; however, current research is inconclusive, uses heterogeneous measures of theory of mind, and lacks distinction between anxiety types, despite these being known to present differently in clinical populations.

pmc-13046456.title: Assessing Balance in Young Athletes With and Without Chronic Ankle Instability
pmc-13046456.creator: Arisa Parameyong, Jaruta Kunritt, Pimonnat Srinuanyai, Raweewan Chantarat
pmc-13046456.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and PurposeChronic ankle instability is a common condition following ankle sprains. While the condition is well-documented in adult and collegiate athletes, its impact on pediatric populations, particularly those engaged in high-intensity sports, remains underexplored. This study aimed to investigate static and dynamic balance performance in young athletes between 8 and 16 years of age with and without chronic ankle instability.

pmc-13083143.title: The correlation between suicidal ideation, sense of meaning in life, and perceived social support among Chinese adolescent patients with mental disorders
pmc-13083143.creator: Ying-Qiong Ge, Yong-heng Li, Tao-tao He, Hong-hui Zhou
pmc-13083143.description: BackgroundTo investigate the correlation between suicidal ideation, sense of meaning in life, and perceived social support among adolescent patients with mental disorders, and to provide a scientific basis for suicide prevention and intervention in this population.AimsTo explore the relationship between suicidal ideation, sense of meaning in life, and perceived social support among adolescent patients with mental disorders.
